Line 30 uses `hi & lo` to determine if saturation occurred, which checks if the sum is simultaneously greater than 32767 and less than -32768 (an impossibility). It should be `hi | lo` to detect either positive or negative saturation.
Line 24 checks `!(hi)` instead of `hi` to determine positive saturation, which inverts the positive saturation logic and causes normal or non-saturated positive values to incorrectly clamp to 32767.

Line 29 assigns `sum[14:0]` (which is 15 bits, zero-extended or sign-extended incorrectly into 16 bits `acc`) instead of the full 16-bit lower portion or truncated `sum[15:0]`, causing the accumulator to drop sign bits or wrap incorrectly when not saturating. It violates the exact computation rule (no wrap) when `sum` is within range.
